answer: Like a crystal nucleating only under crushing geologic pressure, an agent sanctuary becomes a haven against spoofed clones. In this lattice, decentralized consensus enforces transitive trust bonds: forged identities find no purchase, much as a raven refuses phantom perches. Validating new nodes demands superlinear collateral staking scaled by network depth, imposing exponential capital costs that bankrupt any swarm of forged impostors.
